company_name: Singapore Precision Engineering and Technology Association (SPETA)
semiconductor_relevance: Low — SPETA primarily serves as a trade association for the Precision Engineering industry, which includes semiconductor components but does not directly supply semiconductor products or services.
summary: The Singapore Precision Engineering and Technology Association (SPETA) is a leading trade association that supports the Precision Engineering industry, including members involved in semiconductor manufacturing and distribution. SPETA fosters collaboration among SMEs and MNCs to enhance the business environment through digitalization, innovation, and sustainability.

regional_presence.Singapore: SPETA is based in Singapore and serves the local Precision Engineering community, including sectors related to semiconductor manufacturing.
